outer_cv_repeats.pass_rule: mean_nested_auc >= 0.71 and no repeat is materially below B7 local baseline

requirements: Report slice n and positives for every optimized slice.
No n<2000 slice may be the only reason a candidate crosses 0.71.
Report overall, ultra, non-ultra, long, and non-long AUC deltas against B7.
If alpha median or fold alphas concentrate above 0.2 on n<2000 slice, require explicit stability evidence across all outer repeats.
Alpha grids must be fixed in the manifest before any score is computed.

overall improvement is driven primarily by n<2000 slice high-alpha patch
test distribution shifts materially while repeated CV lift is not stable
